info.title: ITMS API
info.description: Unified IT Management System. Every route is versioned in its path (ARCHITECTURE.md §6), every error is an RFC 7807 problem document, and authentication is the session cookie.

get.summary: Issues an antiforgery token for the credential endpoints.

post.summary: Signs in and issues the session cookie.

401.description: Unauthorized

post.summary: Revokes the current session and clears the cookie.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

get.summary: Returns the signed-in account, its roles, and its directory placement.

401.description: Unauthorized

post.summary: Changes the caller's own password and revokes their other sessions.

401.description: Unauthorized

get.summary: Finds active users by name or email, for a picker.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.
No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

get.summary: Lists departments, filtered by search text and optionally including retired ones.

401.description: Unauthorized
No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.
No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

put.summary: Replaces a department's name, code, and description.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

post.summary: Retires a department. Existing references keep resolving.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

post.summary: Brings a retired department back into use.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

get.summary: Lists locations in path order, optionally within one parent or one subtree.

401.description: Unauthorized

post.summary: Creates a location under a parent, or a root organisation.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

get.summary: Reads one location, including its full path.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

put.summary: Renames a location and rewrites the paths of everything beneath it.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

delete.summary: Deletes a location that has no children. A location with children is refused with 409.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

post.summary: Reparents a location, carrying its subtree with it.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

get.summary: Lists ticket categories in picker order, optionally including retired ones.

401.description: Unauthorized
No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.
No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

put.summary: Replaces a ticket category's name, description, and order. Existing tickets follow the rename.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

post.summary: Retires a ticket category. Existing tickets keep resolving it.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

post.summary: Brings a retired ticket category back into use.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

get.summary: Lists ticket priorities most urgent first, optionally including retired ones.

401.description: Unauthorized

post.summary: Creates a ticket priority. The code is chosen here and never changes.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.
No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

put.summary: Replaces a ticket priority's name, description, order, and SLA targets. The code is immutable.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

post.summary: Retires a ticket priority. Existing tickets keep resolving it.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

post.summary: Brings a retired ticket priority back into use.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session it named has expired or been revoked.

get.summary: Reads a ticket's history, newest first.

401.description: Unauthorized

post.summary: Moves a ticket to another status, refusing any transition SPEC.md §2 does not allow.

401.description: Unauthorized

displayName.description: The name shown throughout the product.

roles.description: Their roles. The client uses these to hide what a role cannot use; hiding is never the enforcement (ARCHITECTURE.md §7).

AuthenticatedUserResponse.description:
The account the caller is signed in as. Returned by both `/login` and
`/me`, so the client has one shape to hold for "who am I" however it got there.

currentPassword.description: The password in force. Proving possession is what stops a borrowed session changing it.

newPassword.description: The replacement. Checked against the password policy server-side.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: A password change by the account holder.

status.description:
The status to move to. `Assigned` is not accepted here: a ticket becomes assigned
by assigning it to somebody (WP-1.6), so that the status and the assignee arrive
together. `New` is not accepted either — nothing returns to it.

resolutionNotes.description:
What was done. Required and non-blank when Status is
`Resolved`, and rejected for every other destination, because no other transition
records a resolution and silently dropping the text would lose it.

code.description: A short code such as `FIN`, or `null`. Unique when present.

name.description: The node's own name. Unique among its siblings, case-insensitively.

kind.description: Which level of the hierarchy it is.

parentId.description: The parent node, or `null` to create a root organisation.

description.description: What belongs in this category, or `null`.

sortOrder.description: Where it sits in a picker. Ties are broken by name.

code.description: The stable machine identifier, lower-cased on the way in. Unique and immutable.

name.description: The display name. Unique, case-insensitively, and editable.

description.description: What this priority is for, or `null`.

rank.description: Urgency order, lowest first. Ties are broken by name.

responseTargetMinutes.description: Minutes from creation within which a technician should respond.

resolutionTargetMinutes.description: Minutes from creation within which the ticket should be resolved.

token.description: The request token, sent back in HeaderName.

headerName.description: The header the token belongs in, so the client never hard-codes it.

CsrfTokenResponse.description: The token the browser needs before it may post to a credential endpoint.

DepartmentResponse.description: A department as the API renders it.

status.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body as RFC 7807 allows.

code.description: The machine-readable error identifier, e.g. auth.antiforgery_failed. Present on every problem this system produces itself; absent on one produced by the framework.

LocationKind.description:
What a node in the location tree represents. The five levels SPEC.md §5 names:
Organization → Site → Building → Floor/Area → Room.

name.description: Its own name — "Room G-04", not the whole path.

kind.description: Which level of the hierarchy it is.

parentId.description: Its parent, or `null` at the root.

path.description: The full display path from the root, which is what other modules also receive.

depth.description: How far below the root it sits.

childCount.description:
How many nodes sit directly beneath it. Carried so a caller can render the tree and
know whether a delete will be refused before it tries.

LocationResponse.description: A location as the API renders it.

userName.description: The sign-in name or the email address; either is accepted.

password.description: The password. Never logged, never echoed, never stored outside its hash.

parentId.description:
The new parent, or `null` to move the node to the root — which only
an Organization may be.

total.description: The total number of matching items across all pages.

page.description: The 1-based page number this envelope represents.

pageSize.description: The page size that was applied, after clamping.

totalPages.description: The number of pages the current page size yields for int PagedResult<T>.Total items.

hasNextPage.description: True when a further page exists.

`{ items, total, page, pageSize }`. It is a type rather than an anonymous
object so the shape reaches OpenAPI and, from there, the generated client.

status.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body as RFC 7807 allows.

code.description: The machine-readable error identifier, e.g. auth.antiforgery_failed. Present on every problem this system produces itself; absent on one produced by the framework.

errors.description: Per-field validation messages, keyed by camel-cased field name. Present only on a validation failure.

id.description: The category's id. What a ticket stores, and what a rename does not change.

sortOrder.description: Where it sits in a picker.

TicketCategoryResponse.description: A ticket category as the API renders it.

TicketChangeKind.description: Which dimension of a ticket a history entry records having moved.

fromValue.description: What it read before, or `null` when there was nothing there.

toValue.description: What it reads now, or `null` when the change cleared it.

sequence.description:
Where this line sits among the lines the same change wrote. Entries sharing an
OccurredAt came from one change and are meant to be read together.

actorId.description: Who made it, or `null` when the system did.

actorName.description: Their display name at the time, or `null`.

TicketHistoryEntryResponse.description: One line of a ticket's timeline, as the API renders it.

id.description: The priority's id. What a ticket stores.

code.description: The stable machine identifier — `critical`, `high`. Fixed for the life of the row.

responseTargetMinutes.description: Minutes from creation within which a technician should respond.

resolutionTargetMinutes.description: Minutes from creation within which the ticket should be resolved.

TicketPriorityResponse.description: A ticket priority as the API renders it.

TicketStatus.description: Where a ticket sits in the workflow SPEC.md §2 defines.

number.description: Its human-readable number, so a toast can name it.

status.description: The status it is in now.

changedAt.description: When the move happened, in UTC.

resolvedAt.description: When it was resolved, or `null` — cleared by a reopen.

allowedNextStatuses.description:
Where it may go next, straight from the state machine. WP-1.10 must not render a
transition button the server would refuse, and reading it from here is what stops the
table being written a second time in TypeScript. Empty from a terminal state.

TicketStatusChangeResponse.description: What a ticket looks like immediately after a status change.

code.description: The short code, or `null` to clear it.

description.description: Free text, or `null` to clear it.
Free text, or `null` to clear it.

name.description: The display name. Every ticket already filed under this category follows the rename.

description.description: What belongs in it, or `null` to clear it.

sortOrder.description: Where it sits in a picker.

description.description: What this priority is for, or `null` to clear it.

responseTargetMinutes.description: Minutes from creation within which a technician should respond.

resolutionTargetMinutes.description: Minutes from creation within which the ticket should be resolved.

displayName.description: The name to show on a ticket, comment, or asset history row.

isActive.description: False once deactivated. A deactivated user still owns their history (invariant 9).

UserSummary.description:
The fields another module is allowed to know about a user. It carries no
credential state of any kind — that never leaves Identity.

sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie, issued by POST /api/v1/auth/login and revoked server-side by POST /api/v1/auth/logout. The browser sends it automatically; it cannot be read by script and is never held in browser storage.
sessionCookie.name: itms.session
